title: Inflation, consumer prices (annual percent): Japan, Russia, Sri Lanka and Zimbabwe, 1960-2025
source: World Bank, World Development Indicators (API v2); the series comes from the IMF's International Financial Statistics
series: FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG (inflation: consumer prices, annual percent); columns country (ISO3), year, inflation

notes: WDI last updated 2026-10-08. One row per year with a value: WDI has none for Zimbabwe before 2010 and none for Russia before 1993.
